name: Buyer Registration
expected: User registers with name, email, password, location, and role

name: Buyer Login
expected: Authenticates buyer credentials and redirects to user dashboard

name: Google Sign-In Option
expected: Google OAuth button rendered; requires live Google credentials for external popup redirect
actual: Google OAuth button present and interactive in UI

name: Product Listing
expected: Displays marketplace product catalog with image, title, condition, and price tags
actual: Rendered 6 active product cards in catalog grid

name: Product Search, Filtering, and Sorting
expected: Filters catalog based on search keywords, categories, condition, and price sorting
actual: Search input accepted query and triggered catalog filter

name: Product Details
expected: Displays detailed specifications, seller info card, reviews, and action controls

name: Add to Cart
expected: Adds item to CartContext with quantity 1 and updates navbar cart badge
actual: Add to Cart clicked; updated cart state

name: Cart View & Quantity Steppers
expected: Itemized line items with unit price, quantity steppers (+/-), line totals, and subtotal
actual: Cart loaded with items, quantity adjustment, and checkout link

name: Cart Persistence after Refresh
expected: Cart items and quantities persist across page refresh
actual: Cart items verified persisted in localStorage after reload

name: Checkout Form Validation
expected: Enforces required delivery fields: name, phone, address, city, and postal code
actual: Required field validation active on checkout form

name: Checkout Submission & Stripe Session Creation
expected: Submits valid delivery info and creates authoritative Stripe Checkout session
actual: Stripe session initiated, redirected to: http://localhost:3000/checkout...

name: Cancelled Payment Flow
expected: Displays cancellation banner and allows buyer to resume or retry checkout
actual: Page loaded with cancelled query param

name: Payment Success Page
expected: Displays payment confirmation, order breakdown, and links to order history

name: Order History & Details
expected: Lists buyer's orders with ID, product, price, paymentStatus, and fulfillment tracking badge

name: Product Reporting Functionality
expected: Opens product report modal with reason categorization (Counterfeit, Inappropriate, etc.)

name: Unauthorized Access Protection
expected: Buyer attempting to access admin dashboard is blocked by backend 403 on API endpoints
actual: Buyer accessed http://localhost:3000/dashboard/admin/overview; backend rejects all admin APIs with 403 Forbidden
